title: Heroku free product plans removed
summary: Heroku ended the affected free dyno, Postgres, and Key-Value Store plans starting November 28, 2022.
replacement: Heroku Eco, Mini, or other paid plans
migration_path: Upgrade affected free resources to supported paid Heroku plans before the removal date.
user_impact: Free dynos could no longer run without a paid plan and affected free databases could be converted or deleted depending on account type.
notes: Current Heroku help documentation confirms the 2022 removal boundary.
